text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp. From here on, 
grueling days dedicated to building up 
strength would begin, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Training camp, training camp... Uuu, I'm 
already getting dizzy even before we 
leave...
choice_data_list:
Are you okay? Is the fatigue getting to 
you?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, a bit... I might've taken on way too 
much media work. Shooting five segments in 
a single day is pretty routine now.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by so many people every single 
day... Well, they seem happy, but still...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, could it be—is this what you meant?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I saw it through feng shui. A ring of 
light is coming, bearing a small darkness. 
That small darkness is..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it actually meant, 'I'm going to 
get crazy busy.' Ahahaha..."

"I might have accepted too many requests 
just as she wanted. To help her 
refresh..."
choice_data_list:
How about we hold off on interviews during 
the training camp?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right. Yeah. That might be best! I 
want to make sure I train properly too, 
and besides—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There's one thing that's been on my mind, 
you know? ...Very much so.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Right. ...Look, that one."

—Glancing over by the school gates, I saw 
a familiar sight.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Are you really quitting? I think it's 
still too soon.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Right. Why don't you try some good-luck 
charms to change up the mood? They seem to 
be quite popular lately.

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I don't think there's any point. In the 
end, the reason I can't win is just my own 
unworthiness. ...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...The number hasn't gone down at all. 
Girls who get lost in their worries and 
quit racing.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. I'll try calling out to the 
girls at the training camp as a test, so 
just watch."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hey there, you three! Do you have any 
worries about your running?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll solve everything with a bang using 
feng shui☆ Come on, lay it on me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the girl everyone's talking about... 
Copano Rickey? U-Um...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"We're good on that sort of thing. See 
ya."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Acute-san, could I ask you for some 
advice? It's about training methods, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, of course, of course~. If you're fine 
with me, anytime~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
See? Feng shui is super popular right now, 
but for some reason it just hasn't caught 
on with the Umamusume at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, Ms. Acute's advice is 
always super popular. She's constantly 
surrounded by people.
choice_data_list: I see, so this is what was on your mind.

I see, so this is what was bothering 
you...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I want to make everyone happy! And 
the one person I want to learn about feng 
shui the most is, after all—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
They're girls tackling challenges with all 
their might, after all. That means they 
must carry big worries too. But...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In reality, the number of girls leaving 
Tracen Academy hasn't decreased. The light 
of feng shui hasn't reached them, leaving 
them beyond help...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This is so frustrating... and sad. Sure, 
Acute-san's past experiences might be 
helpful, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer, why do you think the other 
Umamusume won't believe in feng shui?"
choice_data_list: I don't know. But there must be a reason.

I don't know. But it seems like there's a 
reason.

text_block_list.text:
If she's clearly showing no interest, 
there's likely a hidden reason behind it.
And if only we can resolve that—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm going to do my best this 
summer! So you'll believe in me even more. 
And...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"If my Feng Shui can be accepted by all 
the other Umamusume too, then――"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should tweak our strategy going 
forward.
choice_data_list: What kind of plan is that?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Let's cut back on race entries and focus 
more on spreading feng shui."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's how important it is. Helping 
someone through feng shui, to me. That is 
why—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: This summer, I'll face it head-on!
